collection.name: Common English Vocabulary
collection.description: Common English vocabulary grouped by CEFR/IELTS band (B1–C2). IPA + Vietnamese meaning; C1/C2 include English definitions.

meta.note: Claude-authored enrichment (no external LLM). difficulty derived from the curated set's own CEFR/IELTS bands. Vietnamese meanings verified/corrected on enriched rows.

words.definition_en: on the subject of; concerning someone or something
words.example_simple: We talked about our holiday plans at dinner.
words.example_complex: The documentary raises difficult questions about how technology is reshaping our daily lives.

words.definition_en: in or to a foreign country
words.example_simple: My sister wants to study abroad next year.
words.example_complex: Having worked abroad for a decade, she found it surprisingly hard to readjust to life back home.

words.definition_en: completely; used to strongly agree with something
words.example_simple: You are absolutely right about the answer.
words.example_complex: The proposal is absolutely essential if we hope to meet next quarter's ambitious targets.

words.definition_en: a place to live, stay, or sleep in
words.example_simple: The hotel offers cheap accommodation for students.
words.example_complex: The university struggled to provide affordable accommodation for the growing number of international students.

words.definition_en: a movie full of fast, exciting, and violent scenes
words.example_simple: We watched an exciting action film last night.
words.example_complex: Beneath its explosions and car chases, the action film hides a surprisingly thoughtful story about loyalty.

words.definition_en: in fact; used to correct or emphasize something
words.example_simple: I thought it was hard, but it was actually easy.
words.example_complex: Although the plan sounded risky, it actually turned out to be the safest option available.

words.definition_en: the details of where someone lives or a place is located
words.example_simple: Please write your home address on the form.
words.example_complex: The parcel never arrived because the courier had recorded the wrong delivery address.

words.definition_en: a public notice promoting a product, service, or event
words.example_simple: I saw a funny advert for a new phone.
words.example_complex: The advert cleverly appealed to viewers' emotions rather than simply listing the product's features.

words.definition_en: a public notice promoting a product, service, or event
words.example_simple: She saw an advertisement for a new job online.
words.example_complex: Regulators fined the company for running an advertisement that exaggerated the medicine's benefits.

words.definition_en: suggestions about what someone should do
words.example_simple: My teacher gave me good advice about my exam.
words.example_complex: Against his family's advice, he invested his entire savings in the struggling business.

words.definition_en: a room or floor below the ground level of a building
words.example_simple: We keep our old boxes in the basement.
words.example_complex: After the flood, the family spent weeks drying out the basement and replacing the ruined carpets.

words.definition_en: a large low area of land, or a wide open bowl
words.example_simple: The river flows through a wide, green basin.
words.example_complex: Deforestation across the river basin has dramatically increased the risk of seasonal flooding downstream.

words.definition_en: a container made of woven material for carrying things
words.example_simple: She put the apples in a small basket.
words.example_complex: The market stall displayed a wicker basket overflowing with freshly picked strawberries and cherries.

words.definition_en: a team sport where players throw a ball through a hoop
words.example_simple: My friends and I play basketball after school.
words.example_complex: Despite being the shortest player on the court, she dominated the basketball match with her speed.

words.definition_en: a large container you fill with water to wash your body
words.example_simple: The children had a warm bath before bed.
words.example_complex: After the long hike, nothing sounded more inviting than a hot bath and an early night.

words.definition_en: a room with a bath, shower, sink, and usually a toilet
words.example_simple: The bathroom is at the end of the hall.
words.example_complex: The apartment was appealing, but sharing a single bathroom with four roommates soon became frustrating.

words.definition_en: a device that stores and supplies electrical power
words.example_simple: My phone battery is almost dead.
words.example_complex: Engineers are racing to develop a battery that charges faster and lasts far longer than current models.

words.definition_en: relating to Britain or its people
words.example_simple: He speaks with a strong British accent.
words.example_complex: The exhibition traced how British literature shaped ideas of identity across the former empire.

words.definition_en: damaged and no longer whole or working
words.example_simple: The clock is broken, so it doesn't work.
words.example_complex: He tried to repair their broken friendship, but too much trust had already been lost.

words.definition_en: a boy or man with the same parents as you
words.example_simple: My brother is two years older than me.
words.example_complex: Although they argued constantly as children, he now considers his brother his closest friend.

words.definition_en: having the colour of chocolate, wood, or soil
words.example_simple: She has long brown hair and brown eyes.
words.example_complex: The autumn leaves had faded from vivid gold to a dull, crumbling brown along the path.

words.definition_en: a flat round piece of meat served in a bread roll
words.example_simple: I had a burger and chips for lunch.
words.example_complex: The new restaurant claims its plant-based burger tastes indistinguishable from real grilled beef.

words.definition_en: a person who breaks into a building to steal things
words.example_simple: The burglar broke a window to get into the house.
words.example_complex: The burglar had disabled the alarm, so no one noticed the break-in until the following morning.

words.definition_en: the crime of breaking into a building to steal
words.example_simple: There was a burglary at our neighbour's house.
words.example_complex: Police linked the burglary to a wider gang that had targeted homes across the district for months.

words.definition_en: material made from fibres, or a piece used for cleaning
words.example_simple: She cleaned the table with a wet cloth.
words.example_complex: The tailor selected a fine woollen cloth that would drape elegantly without creasing.

words.definition_en: things you wear to cover your body
words.example_simple: I need to buy some new clothes for winter.
words.example_complex: She packed only practical clothes, expecting cold, wet weather throughout the mountain expedition.

words.definition_en: a white or grey mass of water droplets in the sky
words.example_simple: There is not a single cloud in the sky today.
words.example_complex: A thick cloud of ash from the volcano grounded flights across the entire continent for days.

words.definition_en: having many clouds; not clear or bright
words.example_simple: It was cloudy, so we stayed inside.
words.example_complex: The forecast promised sunshine, yet the morning stayed stubbornly cloudy and cold.

words.definition_en: a person who trains a sports team or player
words.example_simple: Our coach taught us how to play better.
words.example_complex: The new coach transformed a losing side into champions within a single remarkable season.

words.definition_en: land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms
words.example_simple: We took a walk in the quiet countryside.
words.example_complex: Tired of city noise, they moved to the countryside in search of a slower, greener life.

words.definition_en: a series of lessons on a particular subject
words.example_simple: I am taking an English course this summer.
words.example_complex: The intensive course covered a year's worth of material in just eight demanding weeks.

words.definition_en: a place where legal cases are heard and judged
words.example_simple: The judge spoke to everyone in the court.
words.example_complex: After years of dispute, the two companies finally settled their argument in court.

words.definition_en: a child of your aunt or uncle
words.example_simple: My cousin lives in another city.
words.example_complex: At the reunion she met a distant cousin she had never even known existed.

words.definition_en: to remove or erase something, especially data
words.example_simple: I need to delete some old photos from my phone.
words.example_complex: He accidentally deleted the report minutes before the deadline, forcing him to rewrite it all.

words.definition_en: having a very pleasant taste or smell
words.example_simple: This soup is really delicious.
words.example_complex: The chef combined simple local ingredients into a surprisingly delicious and memorable dish.

words.vi_meaning: sự giao hàng; việc giao hàng
words.definition_en: the act of taking goods to a place or person
words.example_simple: The pizza delivery arrived in twenty minutes.
words.example_complex: The company promises same-day delivery, but bad weather often delays parcels in rural areas.

words.definition_en: a doctor who treats problems with people's teeth
words.example_simple: I go to the dentist twice a year.
words.example_complex: Nervous about the drill, she nearly cancelled her dentist appointment for the third time.

words.definition_en: to leave, especially to start a journey
words.example_simple: The train will depart in five minutes.
words.example_complex: The expedition was scheduled to depart at dawn, before the mountain winds grew dangerous.

words.definition_en: a large shop selling many kinds of goods in sections
words.example_simple: We bought new shoes at the department store.
words.example_complex: Once a bustling landmark, the old department store now stands empty as shoppers moved online.

words.definition_en: to or on a lower floor of a building
words.example_simple: She went downstairs to answer the door.
words.example_complex: Hearing a strange noise downstairs at midnight, he crept down the steps holding his breath.

words.definition_en: used to stress something surprising or extreme
words.example_simple: It is cold today, and even the dog stayed inside.
words.example_complex: Even after years of practice, she still felt nervous before a big performance.

words.definition_en: the part of the day between afternoon and night
words.example_simple: We usually watch a film in the evening.
words.example_complex: The concert began late in the evening, just as the sky turned a deep orange.

words.definition_en: each one of a group, without exception
words.example_simple: I brush my teeth every morning.
words.example_complex: The teacher checked every essay carefully, leaving detailed comments on each page.

words.definition_en: in or to all places or many places
words.example_simple: I looked everywhere for my keys.
words.example_complex: News of the discovery spread everywhere, reaching newspapers across every continent.

words.definition_en: a formal test of knowledge or ability
words.example_simple: I have a maths exam tomorrow.
words.example_complex: After weeks of revision, she felt confident walking into the final exam.

words.definition_en: extremely good; of very high quality
words.example_simple: The food at that restaurant is excellent.
words.example_complex: Her presentation was excellent, blending clear data with a genuinely engaging story.

words.definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return
words.example_simple: We exchange gifts at Christmas.
words.example_complex: The two scientists met to exchange ideas about how climate change affects ocean currents.

words.definition_en: an outdoor event with rides, games, and stalls
words.example_simple: We rode the big wheel at the fair.
words.example_complex: Every autumn the village holds a fair where local farmers sell fresh produce and homemade jam.

words.definition_en: to move down quickly towards the ground
words.example_simple: Be careful not to fall on the ice.
words.example_complex: The climber gripped the rope tightly, terrified he might fall from the steep cliff.

words.definition_en: a group of related people, especially parents and children
words.example_simple: My family lives in a small town.
words.example_complex: Despite living on different continents, the whole family gathered each summer to celebrate together.

words.definition_en: land used for growing crops or raising animals
words.example_simple: There are cows and sheep on the farm.
words.example_complex: The family farm had been passed down for generations, its fields still worked by hand.

words.definition_en: a person who owns or works on a farm
words.example_simple: The farmer feeds the animals every morning.
words.example_complex: The farmer worried that the sudden drought would ruin an entire season of carefully planted crops.

words.definition_en: a cold cabinet for keeping food fresh
words.example_simple: Put the milk back in the fridge.
words.example_complex: She opened the fridge hopefully, only to find little more than a jar of pickles inside.

words.definition_en: a person you know well and like
words.example_simple: My best friend lives next door.
words.example_complex: A true friend is someone who stays beside you even when everything goes wrong.

words.definition_en: kind, pleasant, and easy to talk to
words.example_simple: The new neighbours are very friendly.
words.example_complex: The hotel's friendly staff made every guest feel genuinely welcome from the moment they arrived.

words.definition_en: the part of something that faces forward
words.example_simple: Please sit in the front of the class.
words.example_complex: A crowd gathered at the front of the building, waiting for the doors to finally open.

words.definition_en: the sweet, seed-bearing part of a plant, eaten as food
words.example_simple: I eat a piece of fruit every day.
words.example_complex: The market stalls overflowed with tropical fruit whose bright colours drew shoppers from across the city.

words.definition_en: a container for drinking, made of hard clear material
words.example_simple: Can I have a glass of water, please?
words.example_complex: He raised his glass and proposed a warm toast to the newlyweds' future happiness.

words.definition_en: two glass lenses in a frame, worn to help you see
words.example_simple: I wear glasses to read.
words.example_complex: Without his glasses, the distant road signs blurred into meaningless smudges of colour.

words.definition_en: relating to the whole world
words.example_simple: Pollution is a global problem.
words.example_complex: The company built a global network of suppliers spanning more than forty different countries.

words.definition_en: coverings for the hands, worn for warmth or protection
words.example_simple: Wear your gloves; it is cold outside.
words.example_complex: The surgeon pulled on sterile gloves before carefully beginning the delicate operation.

words.definition_en: to move or travel from one place to another
words.example_simple: I go to school by bus.
words.example_complex: They decided to go abroad for a year, hoping to experience a completely different culture.

words.definition_en: the father of one of your parents
words.example_simple: My grandfather tells us funny stories.
words.example_complex: Her grandfather, who had fought in the war, rarely spoke about the things he had seen.

words.definition_en: the mother of one of your parents
words.example_simple: My grandmother bakes delicious cakes.
words.example_complex: Every recipe she treasured had been handed down from her grandmother, written in faded ink.

words.definition_en: the parents of your mother or father
words.example_simple: We visit our grandparents every weekend.
words.example_complex: The children spent whole summers with their grandparents, learning to fish and garden in the countryside.

words.definition_en: the son of your son or daughter
words.example_simple: Her grandson is learning to walk.
words.example_complex: The old man beamed with pride as his grandson accepted the university degree on stage.

words.definition_en: a small round fruit that grows in bunches, used for wine
words.example_simple: I bought a bunch of grapes at the market.
words.example_complex: The vineyard's finest grapes were hand-picked at dawn, when their sugar levels were perfect.

words.definition_en: very good, large, or important
words.example_simple: We had a great time at the party.
words.example_complex: Winning the scholarship was a great achievement that opened doors she had never imagined.

words.definition_en: a continuous pain in your head
words.example_simple: I have a headache, so I need to rest.
words.example_complex: After staring at the screen for hours, he developed a pounding headache that no pill could ease.

words.definition_en: devices worn over the ears to listen privately
words.example_simple: She listens to music with her headphones.
words.example_complex: He slipped on his noise-cancelling headphones, letting the busy office fade into calm silence.

words.definition_en: the condition of your body and mind
words.example_simple: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
words.example_complex: Doctors increasingly recognise that mental health deserves the same attention as physical health.

words.definition_en: the organ that pumps blood around the body
words.example_simple: Running makes your heart beat faster.
words.example_complex: As she stepped onto the stage, her heart pounded so loudly she could barely think.

words.definition_en: weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move
words.example_simple: This box is too heavy to carry.
words.example_complex: Heavy rain flooded the streets, forcing the festival organisers to cancel the outdoor events.

words.definition_en: how tall or high someone or something is
words.example_simple: What is the height of that tree?
words.example_complex: The tower's dizzying height gave visitors a sweeping view of the entire coastline below.

words.definition_en: an aircraft that flies using spinning blades on top
words.example_simple: A helicopter flew over our house.
words.example_complex: The rescue helicopter hovered above the stranded hikers, lowering a rope through the fierce wind.

words.definition_en: relaxed and casual, not official or formal
words.example_simple: The party has an informal dress code.
words.example_complex: During the informal chat over coffee, the two managers reached an agreement no formal meeting had achieved.

words.definition_en: facts or details about someone or something
words.example_simple: I need more information about the trip.
words.example_complex: Reporters carefully checked every piece of information before publishing the sensitive story.

words.definition_en: not guilty of a crime or wrongdoing
words.example_simple: The court found him innocent.
words.example_complex: After years in prison, new evidence finally proved the man had been completely innocent all along.

words.definition_en: a person who teaches a skill or activity
words.example_simple: My driving instructor is very patient.
words.example_complex: The diving instructor calmly explained the safety rules before guiding the nervous beginners underwater.

words.definition_en: the global network linking computers worldwide
words.example_simple: I found the recipe on the Internet.
words.example_complex: A reliable Internet connection has become essential for people who work remotely from home.

words.definition_en: casual trousers made of strong blue cotton denim
words.example_simple: She wears jeans and a T-shirt at the weekend.
words.example_complex: He rolled up the frayed hems of his faded jeans before wading into the shallow stream.

words.definition_en: work that someone does regularly to earn money
words.example_simple: My sister has a new job at the bank.
words.example_complex: After months of interviews, she finally landed a job that matched her skills and ambitions.

words.definition_en: a person who writes news for papers, TV, or online
words.example_simple: The journalist asked the mayor many questions.
words.example_complex: As an investigative journalist, she spent years exposing corruption that powerful officials had hidden.

words.definition_en: an act of travelling from one place to another
words.example_simple: The journey to school takes twenty minutes by bus.
words.example_complex: Their overland journey across the desert tested both their endurance and their friendship.

words.definition_en: a Japanese sport of unarmed combat and throwing
words.example_simple: He goes to judo lessons every Tuesday evening.
words.example_complex: Years of judo training had taught her to use an opponent's momentum against them.

words.definition_en: the seventh month of the year, after June
words.example_simple: We are going on holiday in July.
words.example_complex: The festival, held every July, draws thousands of visitors to the coastal town.

words.definition_en: to push yourself off the ground into the air
words.example_simple: The children like to jump on the bed.
words.example_complex: The gazelle jumped effortlessly over the fence and vanished into the tall grass.

words.definition_en: a warm knitted garment worn over the upper body
words.example_simple: Put on a jumper because it is cold outside.
words.example_complex: She knitted him a thick woollen jumper that kept out even the sharpest winter wind.

words.definition_en: a small shaped metal object that opens a lock
words.example_simple: I can't find the key to the front door.
words.example_complex: He fumbled in the darkness for the key, certain he had left it in his coat pocket.

words.definition_en: a set of keys for typing or playing music
words.example_simple: She types quickly on her computer keyboard.
words.example_complex: His fingers glided across the keyboard as he composed the melody late into the night.

words.definition_en: an informal word for a child or young person
words.example_simple: The kids are playing in the garden.
words.example_complex: Even as a kid, she showed the discipline that would later make her a champion.

words.definition_en: a unit of weight equal to one thousand grams
words.example_simple: Can I have a kilo of oranges, please?
words.example_complex: The recipe called for two kilos of ripe tomatoes, slowly roasted for a rich sauce.

words.definition_en: a male ruler of a country, usually by birth
words.example_simple: The king lived in a large castle.
words.example_complex: The ageing king reluctantly handed his crown to a son he barely trusted.

words.definition_en: a room where food is prepared and cooked
words.example_simple: Mum is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
words.example_complex: The smell of fresh bread filled the kitchen while rain drummed against the windows.

words.definition_en: similar to; in the same way as something
words.example_simple: She looks like her mother.
words.example_complex: Moving like a shadow, the cat slipped between the chairs without making a sound.

words.definition_en: a large wild cat that lives mainly in Africa
words.example_simple: The lion is sleeping under a tree.
words.example_complex: A lone lion stalked the herd, waiting patiently for the weakest animal to stray.

words.definition_en: one of the two soft edges of the mouth
words.example_simple: He bit his lip when he felt nervous.
words.example_complex: A faint smile touched her lips as she recalled that unforgettable summer.

words.definition_en: coloured makeup applied to the lips
words.example_simple: She put on red lipstick before the party.
words.example_complex: A smudge of crimson lipstick on the glass was the only trace she had been there.

words.definition_en: a metric unit for measuring liquid volume
words.example_simple: I bought a litre of milk from the shop.
words.example_complex: The engine consumed nearly ten litres of fuel on the long mountain climb.

words.definition_en: bread shaped and baked in one whole piece
words.example_simple: She bought a loaf of bread for breakfast.
words.example_complex: The baker pulled a golden loaf from the oven, its crust crackling as it cooled.

words.definition_en: relating to a particular small area or place
words.example_simple: We buy vegetables from the local market.
words.example_complex: The campaign relied on local volunteers who knew every street and family in town.

words.definition_en: fastened shut so it cannot be opened freely
words.example_simple: The door was locked, so we couldn't get in.
words.example_complex: The documents stayed locked in a vault that only two people could open.

words.definition_en: measuring a great distance or amount of time
words.example_simple: We waited a long time for the bus.
words.example_complex: After a long and gruelling negotiation, both sides finally reached a fragile agreement.

words.definition_en: a thin book of articles and pictures, published regularly
words.example_simple: She reads a fashion magazine on the train.
words.example_complex: The magazine's cover story sparked a national debate that lasted for weeks.

words.definition_en: to create or produce something by working
words.example_simple: I want to make a cake for my brother.
words.example_complex: The company plans to make its products entirely from recycled materials by next year.

words.definition_en: the legal union of two people as partners
words.example_simple: Their marriage has lasted for thirty years.
words.example_complex: A successful marriage, she believed, depended less on romance than on daily patience.

words.definition_en: having a husband or wife; joined in marriage
words.example_simple: My aunt got married last summer.
words.example_complex: Married for barely a year, the young couple were already learning to compromise.

words.definition_en: the study of numbers, shapes, and calculations
words.example_simple: Maths is my favourite subject at school.
words.example_complex: Her talent for maths let her solve the puzzle that had baffled the whole class.

words.definition_en: the fifth month of the year, after April
words.example_simple: The flowers bloom in May.
words.example_complex: By late May the orchard was heavy with blossom and loud with bees.

words.definition_en: the food eaten at one time, like lunch
words.example_simple: We had a big meal at the restaurant.
words.example_complex: They lingered over the meal, savouring both the food and each other's company.

words.definition_en: the flesh of animals eaten as food
words.example_simple: She doesn't eat meat because she is vegetarian.
words.example_complex: The chef seared the meat quickly to seal in its rich, smoky flavour.

words.definition_en: a person who repairs machines and engines
words.example_simple: The mechanic fixed my car in an hour.
words.example_complex: A gifted mechanic, he could diagnose an engine fault just by listening to it run.

words.definition_en: the newspapers, TV, and internet that spread news
words.example_simple: The media reported the story all week.
words.example_complex: The scandal dominated the media for months, forcing the minister to resign.

words.definition_en: of a middle size, amount, or degree
words.example_simple: I would like a medium coffee, please.
words.example_complex: Cook the sauce over medium heat, stirring gently until it thickens slightly.

words.definition_en: a short written message to help you remember
words.example_simple: She left a note on the kitchen table.
words.example_complex: He scribbled a hasty note explaining his absence and slipped it under her door.

words.definition_en: a book of blank pages for writing notes
words.example_simple: I write my homework in a notebook.
words.example_complex: Her worn notebook was crammed with sketches, half-formed ideas, and quotations she loved.

words.definition_en: not anything; no single thing at all
words.example_simple: There is nothing in the fridge to eat.
words.example_complex: He searched every drawer but found nothing that could explain her sudden disappearance.

words.definition_en: to see or become aware of something
words.example_simple: Did you notice the new shop on the corner?
words.example_complex: Only later did she notice how carefully he had avoided answering the question.

words.definition_en: a board for pinning up notices and messages
words.example_simple: The timetable is on the noticeboard by the door.
words.example_complex: A faded poster on the noticeboard advertised a concert that had happened years ago.

words.definition_en: a long written story about imaginary people
words.example_simple: She is reading a novel about a young detective.
words.example_complex: His debut novel wove together three generations of a family torn apart by war.

words.definition_en: the eleventh month of the year, after October
words.example_simple: My birthday is in November.
words.example_complex: By early November the days had grown noticeably shorter and much colder.

words.definition_en: at the present time or moment
words.example_simple: I am busy now, so call me later.
words.example_complex: Having finished her degree, she is now weighing several competing job offers.

words.definition_en: one single time; at some time in the past
words.example_simple: I go swimming once a week.
words.example_complex: The town, once a thriving port, now relies almost entirely on tourism.

words.definition_en: a round vegetable with a strong smell and taste
words.example_simple: She cut an onion for the soup.
words.example_complex: The recipe calls for a finely diced onion sautéed until soft and golden.

words.definition_en: connected to or available through the internet
words.example_simple: I bought these shoes online.
words.example_complex: Many companies now offer online training so employees can learn at their own pace.

words.definition_en: no one or nothing more than; just this
words.example_simple: I only have five dollars left.
words.example_complex: She was the only candidate who could speak all three of the required languages.

words.definition_en: to move so as to allow access; not closed
words.example_simple: Please open the window; it's hot in here.
words.example_complex: The museum remains open late on Fridays, allowing visitors to linger over the exhibits.

words.definition_en: a play set to music in which words are sung
words.example_simple: We saw an opera at the theatre last night.
words.example_complex: Her powerful soprano voice made her a celebrated star of the international opera stage.

words.definition_en: thin material for writing, printing, or wrapping
words.example_simple: Write your name on this piece of paper.
words.example_complex: The professor asked us to submit a ten-page paper analysing the causes of the war.

words.definition_en: a person's mother and father
words.example_simple: My parents live in a small town.
words.example_complex: Both her parents worked long hours, yet they never missed a single school performance.

words.definition_en: a public grassy area; to leave a vehicle somewhere
words.example_simple: The children play in the park every afternoon.
words.example_complex: Unable to find a space nearby, he had to park the car three blocks from the office.

words.definition_en: a brightly coloured tropical bird that can copy sounds
words.example_simple: Their parrot can say hello.
words.example_complex: The parrot startled our guests by suddenly repeating a phrase it had overheard for weeks.

words.definition_en: a social event where people gather to enjoy themselves
words.example_simple: We had a party for her birthday.
words.example_complex: The office threw a lively party to celebrate the successful launch of the new product.

words.definition_en: to move past; to succeed in a test
words.example_simple: Could you pass me the salt, please?
words.example_complex: She studied every evening for a month, determined to pass the difficult driving test.

words.definition_en: made dirty or harmful by waste or chemicals
words.example_simple: The river near the factory is very polluted.
words.example_complex: Residents complained that the heavily polluted air was worsening their children's asthma.

words.definition_en: harmful substances that damage air, water, or land
words.example_simple: Cars cause a lot of pollution in the city.
words.example_complex: The government introduced strict laws in an effort to reduce pollution from heavy industry.

words.definition_en: an area of water for swimming; a small body of liquid
words.example_simple: The children swam in the pool all afternoon.
words.example_complex: The hotel's rooftop pool offered a stunning view of the city skyline at sunset.

words.definition_en: having little money; of low quality
words.example_simple: The poor family could not afford a new car.
words.example_complex: Despite growing up in a poor neighbourhood, she won a scholarship to a top university.

words.definition_en: a place where people go to drink and socialise
